# WeChat

Read and answer WeChat Official Account messages, with automations and webhooks, through the Zernio API

import { PlatformCapabilities } from '@/components/platform-capabilities';

Connect your verified WeChat Official Account (Service Account). Messages land in the [inbox](/messages/list-inbox-conversations) next to WhatsApp, LINE and your social DMs.

## Quick reference

## Before you start

You need a verified Service Account and admin access to the [Weixin Official Accounts Platform](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/). Subscription Accounts and unverified accounts are not supported.

## Connect

Add Zernio's IPs (`GET /v1/connect/wechat/ip-whitelist`) to the account's API IP whitelist. Send the AppID and AppSecret to `POST /v1/connect/wechat/credentials`, then paste the server values it returns. [Connect](/platforms/wechat/connect) has every step.

## Common errors

- **`wechat_ip_not_whitelisted`**: Zernio's IPs are not on the API IP whitelist yet. Add them and connect again.
- **No messages arrive**: Server Configuration is not enabled, or its Token or EncodingAESKey does not match.
- **Reply rejected**: more than 48 hours passed since the customer's last message, or 5 replies were already sent in that window.
